intro:
Foshan Ancestral Temple: lion dance at 10:00, Wong Fei-hung and Ip Man halls
Lingnan Tiandi: old streets, lunch, Cantonese opera
Shunde: Qinghui Garden, Huagai Road
Shunde dinner; back ~19:45

food.name: Hotel breakfast
food.desc: Early start; the hotel is quickest

food.name: Breakfast shops on Tiyu Xilu (体育西路)
food.desc: Rice rolls and congee, taken away into the car

items.title: Chartered car: K Hotel → Foshan Ancestral Temple
items.note: Normally ~50 min–1 hr. On the New Year holiday Saturday, traffic to Foshan is heavier and may take ~1 hr 15 min, so departure is at 08:00, arriving after 09:00 — in time for the 10:00 lion dance.
items.tip: Price, duration, and whether tolls and parking are included should be agreed before the car is booked.

route.title: K Hotel → Foshan Ancestral Temple
route.pick: Outside K Hotel (81 Huangpu Avenue West); the exact spot is agreed with the driver
route.drop: Near the Ancestral Temple entrance; the exact spot is unconfirmed and depends on the driver and traffic that day

items.title: Foshan Ancestral Temple (佛山祖庙)
items.note: Open 08:30–18:00. The Wong Fei-hung Memorial Hall and Ip Man Hall are inside the grounds; one ticket covers everything.. The car does not follow the group; the driver makes their own arrangements and picks the group up at the temple at 14:35.

route.title: Main Hall (祖庙大殿)
route.desc: First built in the Northern Song dynasty, dedicated to the god Beidi. Look up at the coloured ceramic ridge figures, plus the wood and brick carvings — the finest Lingnan architecture on site.

route.title: Lion dance performance area (醒狮表演场地)
route.walk: The venue is shown on the notice at the entrance
route.desc: Arrive 15 min early to get front-row spots.
route.tip: Lion dance and kung fu shows are suspended in rain; venue and times are per the temple's notice on the day.

route.title: Lion dance and kung fu show (醒狮、武术表演)
route.desc: Daily 10:00–10:40, with afternoon shows at 14:15 and 15:30. Crowded over New Year, so spots should be taken early.

route.title: Wong Fei-hung Memorial Hall (黄飞鸿纪念馆)
route.desc: The life and kung fu of Foshan martial arts master Wong Fei-hung.
route.tip: One listing says the Wong Fei-hung Memorial Hall has been closed since May 2026; this should be checked before the trip. If closed, more time is spent at the Main Hall and Ip Man Hall.

route.title: Ip Man Hall (叶问堂)
route.desc: Memorial hall for Wing Chun master Ip Man; wooden training dummies are available for photos.

items.title: Lingnan Tiandi (岭南天地): stroll and lunch
items.note: ~10 min walk from the temple; no car needed. Foshan's best-preserved old town quarter: stroll, lunch and souvenirs, then back to the temple's Wanfu Stage for opera and the car.

route.title: Lingnan Tiandi heritage buildings
route.desc: All four are near the central axis, a few minutes apart; each is passed on the way and entered only if it appeals.

food.name: Clock Tower (钟楼)
food.desc: Landmark on the central axis, with ceramic wall sculptures

food.name: Jian Family Villas (简氏别墅)
food.desc: Western-style villas built by the Double Happiness founders; the “Young Ladies' Tower”

food.name: Longtang Poetry Society (龙塘诗社, “Little White House”)
food.desc: Chinese-Western white house; exhibitions are often held

food.name: Wedding House (嫁娶屋, 文会里)
food.desc: Wedding dress and a bridal sedan chair can be tried for photos

route.title: Lunch
route.tip: These names come from older guides; check what is open on the day.

food.name: Taigenbao Rice-free Congee (太艮堡毋米粥)
food.desc: Shunde cuisine; signature is a congee hotpot made with rice broth only

route.title: Old shops and souvenirs
route.walk: Short walk inside the quarter after lunch
route.desc: All inside the quarter, steps apart; each is passed on the way and entered for souvenirs if wanted.

food.name: Li Zhongsheng Tang original shop (李众胜堂祖铺)
food.desc: Century-old pharmacy, home of Po Chai pills

food.name: Lei Hei Kee (李禧记) and Foshan Gong (佛山公)
food.desc: Souvenirs: blind man's cakes, bengsha, maltose candy

food.name: China Seasoning Culture Museum (中国调味文化馆)
food.desc: History of Foshan soy sauce; a quick loop

food.name: Shiwan Winery (石湾酒庄, Wine Merchants' Guild Hall 酒行会馆)
food.desc: Shiwan Yubingshao rice wine; five minutes is enough

route.title: Cantonese opera at Wanfu Stage (万福台)
route.walk: ~10 min walk back to the temple
route.desc: Weekends and holidays 14:00–15:30 on a Qing-dynasty opera stage. About half an hour is enough to get a feel for Lingnan opera.
route.tip: Re-entry to the temple may require a ticket; ask at morning entry whether re-entry is allowed. Show times are per the notice on the day.

route.title: Board the chartered car at the temple
route.pick: Outside the Ancestral Temple; the exact spot is unconfirmed and agreed with the driver

route.title: Foshan Ancestral Temple → Qinghui Garden, Daliang
route.pick: Outside the Ancestral Temple (same spot as above)
route.drop: Near the Qinghui Garden entrance (Qinghui Road); the exact spot is unconfirmed and agreed with the driver

items.title: Daliang: Qinghui Garden and Huagai Road

route.title: Qinghui Garden (清晖园)
route.desc: One of the Four Great Gardens of Lingnan: small bridges, streams, bamboo, carved windows. Over an hour is allowed.
route.tip: The garden closes in the early evening; check the last-entry time at the gate on arrival.

route.title: Huagai Road Pedestrian Street (华盖路步行街)
route.desc: Daliang's oldest arcade street; short, 30–40 min is enough. Lined with old brands, snack shops and souvenir shops; a beef offal stall nearby is good for a skewer on the go.

route.title: Double-skin milk at Renxin (仁信老铺双皮奶)
route.desc: Shunde's classic double-skin milk from an old shop; one bowl is shared, leaving room for dinner.
route.tip: The exact location of the Huagai Road branch is unconfirmed; it should be looked for on arrival.

route.title: Lunjiao cake (伦教糕) and souvenirs
route.desc: Shunde's white sugar cake, lightly sweet and slightly tangy; some can be bought as gifts.

items.title: Walk to dinner
items.note: Both restaurants are a few minutes' walk from Qinghui Garden and Huagai Road.

items.title: Dinner: cooked Shunde dishes
items.note: Both serve cooked food only, so no concern about kids and raw fish.

food.name: Xiangyunsha Garden Hotel (香云纱园林酒店)
food.desc: 25 Qinghui Road, right next to Qinghui Garden; a long-standing Shunde name. Recommended: open-fire roast goose, fried shrimp cake with stir-fried milk

food.name: Daliang Rongbian Spare Rib Rice, Branch 3 (大良容边排骨饭（三店）)
food.desc: 2/F Guangfeng Building, beside Qinghui Garden and Huagai Road. Signatures: steamed spare rib rice, sizzling clay pots, meatball soup, with double-skin milk to finish

items.tip: Rongbian Branch 3 opens for dinner at 17:30, so arriving then means no queue. Tel 13450801998.

route.title: Dinner restaurant → chartered car
route.pick: Outside the dinner restaurant (near Qinghui Garden and Huagai Road); the exact spot is agreed with the driver

items.title: Chartered car: Shunde → Guangzhou
items.note: Leaving at 18:15 avoids the worst of the rush; ~1 hr 20 min–1 hr 30 min expected on a holiday Saturday, back at the hotel around 19:35–19:45.
items.tip: Traffic into Guangzhou is worst at rush hour; the driver can be asked to pick a less congested route by navigation.

route.title: Shunde → K Hotel
route.drop: Outside K Hotel (81 Huangpu Avenue West); the exact spot is agreed with the driver
